# Hasnain Qureshi

> Full-stack developer in Karachi, Pakistan, available remotely to teams in the United Kingdom, United States and worldwide. Open to full-time remote roles and selected client projects.

Hasnain builds React and Next.js interfaces, Node.js APIs, SQL-backed SaaS products, React Native applications and real-time systems. This file is a navigation summary; the linked pages describe his work and services.

## Tools

- [Free website tools](https://hasnainqureshi.online/tools/): Overview of the free browser-based tools below.
- [Website cost calculator](https://hasnainqureshi.online/tools/website-cost-calculator/): Free planning range for business and commercial property websites, with visible work-hour and rate assumptions. It is not a quote.
- [Website brief builder](https://hasnainqureshi.online/tools/website-brief-builder/): Free browser-based tool that turns answers about goals, visitors, pages, content, timing and budget into a website project brief.
- [Website health check](https://hasnainqureshi.online/tools/website-health-check/): Runs Google Lighthouse through PageSpeed Insights on a public page and explains speed, search basics and accessibility results in plain English.

- [Website feedback and redesign planner](https://hasnainqureshi.online/tools/website-feedback-tool/): Free screenshot annotation with numbered pins, arrows, highlights, priorities, PNG export and a matching developer brief. Local processing; no URL capture or online sharing.
- [CSV cleaner and import checker](https://hasnainqureshi.online/tools/csv-cleaner/): Free local CSV structural checks, exact duplicate and blank-row detection, inconsistent-column handling, reviewed cleanup, UTF-8 CSV downloads and a change report. No XLSX support or destination-specific schema validation.

## Original worked guides

- [Fix CSV import errors: a worked contacts example](https://hasnainqureshi.online/insights/fix-csv-import-errors/): Find inconsistent CSV columns, quoted commas, blank rows and duplicate contacts. Follow a reproducible example with source and reviewed downloads.
- [Map CSV columns to a destination template](https://hasnainqureshi.online/insights/csv-column-mapping/): Map source CSV fields to destination headers, mark required fields and export unresolved records with a reusable local recipe.
- [Website redesign brief example: scope, feedback and acceptance](https://hasnainqureshi.online/insights/website-redesign-brief-example/): Use an original website redesign brief with annotated examples, priorities, owners and acceptance criteria. Download the brief and edit your own.
- [Commercial property website launch checklist](https://hasnainqureshi.online/insights/commercial-property-website-checklist/): Review availability, floor plans, CMS ownership, enquiry delivery and launch redirects for UK commercial property and US commercial real estate websites.
- [Duplicate customer IDs in CSV: keep conflicting records](https://hasnainqureshi.online/insights/duplicate-customer-ids-csv/): Identify repeated customer IDs without merging conflicting contact records. Download an original conflict sample and review the surviving and unresolved records.
- [Prepare a HubSpot contacts CSV: checks before import](https://hasnainqureshi.online/insights/hubspot-contacts-csv-preparation/): Prepare a contact CSV for HubSpot with explicit property mapping and identifier review. Includes synthetic samples, limited local checks and official references.
- [How to give website feedback a developer can implement](https://hasnainqureshi.online/insights/website-feedback-developer-handoff/): Turn vague website feedback into reproducible change requests with a screenshot, owner, priority and observable acceptance criteria. Download the template.
- [Service marketplace operator dashboard: first-release scope](https://hasnainqureshi.online/insights/service-marketplace-operator-dashboard/): Define marketplace request queues, provider review, exceptions, role permissions and audit evidence before building an operator dashboard.

- [Data import and integration development](https://hasnainqureshi.online/services/data-import-integration/): Remote UK and US service; scope mapping, validation and API work.
